about: DISCLOSED PARTIAL (fix/harness-object-pairing, coordinator ruling 2026-11-19): where the counts differ, object records pair by value, never by position (`objectRecords.js::alignByValue`); a family our side drew fewer of BY NAME (`ourSide.js` partialFamilies) is graded on what it draws (`compare.mjs::compareObjects`): every drawn record agreeing is WITHHELD (objects:partial), one that differs is a DIVERGE. Every rule, broken once, must turn its rail red.

mutants.mutant: records pair by position again (newest-end) where the counts differ
mutants.from: const { pairs, unpairedVendor, unpairedOurs, byValue } = alignByValue(vendor, ours, score)
mutants.to: const { pairs, unpairedVendor, unpairedOurs, byValue } = { ...alignNewest(vendor, ours), byValue: vendor.length !== ours.length }
mutants.expectRed: our level lines pair with TradingView

mutants.mutant: the partial rule is off: a family drawn in part by name is a count DIVERGE again
a drawn record that differs is read as agreeing (a wrong drawing passes as a partial)
mutants.expectRed: a drawn line at the wrong price

mutants.mutant: no pairing at all reads as agreement
mutants.from: if (!p) return { agree: false, first: 'no record of it was paired field by field' }
mutants.to: if (!p) return { agree: true, first: null }

mutants.mutant: a family we hold MORE of is graded as a partial too
a partial's drawn label texts are not checked against TradingView's
mutants.expectRed: a drawn label text TradingView does not hold

mutants.mutant: objects v2 counts a partial's withheld records as a difference
our side never names the families it drew fewer of
a family nobody named is graded as a partial
